precision: FP32 input, assignments, centroid/statistic state; backend-native reduction order/precision
initialization: Identical FP32 centroids from first k rows of np.random.RandomState(seed).permutation(n), prepared once before warmup/timing and passed explicitly to both methods. This does not reproduce CUDA RNG initialization.
budget: Integer training-pass caps 2,2,2,2,3; max_iter with tol=0/n_init=1 for Lloyd, quality-law epoch budget for e-means. Strict Lloyd convergence can stop earlier; actual iterations recorded.
finalization: Lloyd mean updates and e-means last_epoch moving-assignment means remain algorithm-specific; all produce fresh nearest-final-centroid labels and inertia inside timing. e-means online-label capture disabled. sklearn native final E-step used without an added duplicate pass.

preparation_outside_timer: Metal resident FP32 data and initial-centroid upload and preparation
timing.warmup: One identical complete untimed fit for each method.
timing.before_each_timed_fit: Release previous timed output, garbage collect, clear Metal allocator cache where applicable, synchronize Metal before start. CPU matrices remain resident.
inside_timer: fresh final nearest-centroid labels and inertia
timing.adaptive_repetitions: One timed call; if first fit is under 2 seconds, run two additional calls and retain median of 3.
timing.summary: Per-seed time is median of timed calls; quality is from first timed fit. A single seed has no seed-variability estimate.
timing.os_caches: OS file and shader caches are not flushed. This is warmed resident-data timing, not cold-machine or upload-inclusive end-to-end timing.
timing.sklearn: Unmodified public sklearn.cluster.KMeans with algorithm=lloyd,copy_x=False,n_init=1,tol=0; exact cached input is reloaded after warmup and before every timed call, outside timing. Fit validation/centering/scratch inside timer.
timing.metal: prepare_device outside timer, train_device plus any final-label wrapper inside; raw FP32 resident data, bounded centering tiles, host full-input reference released.
timing.faiss: Unmodified pinned NumpyEmeans train, followed by a bounded Faiss IndexFlatL2 fresh assignment/inertia wrapper inside timing.
timing.numerical: Native final-label dtype retained; shared quality scorer supplies comparable FP64 residual MSE.

memory.sampling: External parent sampler only across each timed fit handshake, baseline and phase peak retained; do not use process lifetime peaks.
memory.allocator: MLX active/cached/peak allocation reported separately; never sum these with process metrics.
memory.semantics: Process peaks include resident input and retained allocator cache, not only algorithm workspace. Sampling may miss short transients; no claim of deterministic minimum memory.
memory.telemetry: Do not run additional GPU/power telemetry during primary measurements.
memory.sklearn: copy_x=False avoids a second input copy during fit, but unmodified empty-cluster relocation can materialize multiple full-input-size temporaries; any paging/failure must be reported.

cpu.reference: Unmodified pinned NumpyEmeans with faiss.knn CPU assignment.
cpu.sklearn: OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 before imports; actual model._n_threads and threadpoolctl inventory recorded; native sklearn BLAS-limiting behavior retained.

quality.test: Exact cached official test half from pinned paper_data and paper_splits fingerprints.
quality.scorer: Shared Faiss IndexFlatL2 FP32 nearest-centroid assignment, followed by direct FP64 squared residuals.
quality.heldout_caveat: Preserve published splits including known duplicate vectors shared between evaluation and training: combined validation+test overlaps are DEEP 4 and SPACEV 45 at 10M. Do not claim all holdouts duplicate-disjoint.

limitations: One seed, full warmup then adaptive1or3timedfits; no confidence intervals.
Equal pass budget is not equal quality or equal update count.
Prior fractional-budget/online-label-only results cannot enter primary ratios.
Lloyd and e-means have algorithm-specific empty-cluster handling and updates.
